# CheckOff Books

> CheckOff Books is a done-for-you, statement-based bookkeeping service for small businesses in the United States. Clients upload monthly bank and credit-card statements (PDF or CSV); CheckOff Books categorizes and reconciles the transactions and delivers a review-ready, cash-basis Profit & Loss. No QuickBooks, no accounting software, and no bank linking. CheckOff Books is a Haven Lane Advisory company, founded by Luella (Willaman) Shoemaker, EA.

Pricing: $79/month for up to 3 accounts; $10/month for each additional account; cancel anytime. Free trial through December 31, 2026: one account, one month of bookkeeping, no credit card.

CheckOff Books does not prepare tax returns, provide tax advice, run payroll, or send invoices. Reports are cash basis only; a Balance Sheet is available on request with additional information.

## Services
- [Statement-based bookkeeping](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/statement-based-bookkeeping): monthly bookkeeping from uploaded statements
- [Bookkeeping without QuickBooks](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/bookkeeping-without-quickbooks)
- [Catch-up bookkeeping](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/catch-up-bookkeeping): bring past months current
- [Back-taxes bookkeeping](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/back-taxes-bookkeeping): reconstruct records for unfiled tax years
- [Bookkeeping for contractors and trades](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/bookkeeping-for-contractors)
- [Bookkeeping for consultants and solo professionals](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/bookkeeping-for-consultants)
- [Free trial](https://www.checkoffbooks.com/free-trial)
